title: Quality management systems — Requirements AMENDMENT 1: Climate action changes
description: An amendment to the Malaysian Standard MS ISO 9001:2015, which is identical to ISO 9001:2015. This amendment introduces new requirements for organizations to determine if climate change is a relevant issue to their Quality Management System (QMS) and to consider climate-related needs and expectations of interested parties.

key_changes.change: Add the following sentence at the end of the subclause: 'The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.'
key_changes.reference: Clause 4.1 Add the following sentence at the end of the subclause: The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.[reference:0]

key_changes.clause: 4.2 (Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties)
key_changes.change: Add the following note at the end of the subclause: 'NOTE: Relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.'
key_changes.reference: 4.2 Add the following note at the end of the subclause: NOTE Relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.[reference:1]

technical_committee: Technical Committee on Quality Management and Quality Assurance - TC 2 on Quality Systems
industry_standards_committee: Industry Standards Committee on Quality Management and Quality Assurance

implementation_requirements.transition_period: No transition period provided; changes must be implemented immediately and considered in all relevant audits.
implementation_requirements.impact_assessment: Organizations must assess whether climate change is relevant to their QMS and, if so, document how it is addressed.

background_and_justification.reason: To ensure climate change is considered in all management systems, following the ISO London Declaration.
background_and_justification.reference: This update of ISO9001 is the result of the #ParisAgreement and a #IAF/#ISO Joint Communiqué on the addition of #Climate Change considerations to #Management #System #Standards.[reference:2]
